elements.name: The Chariot
elements.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

elements.name: Death
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in death saving throws.

elements.name: The Emperor
elements.desc: Fire, cold and lightning damage you deal ignores resistance.
elements.name: The Fool
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a spell that does not deal damage, you can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.

elements.name: The Hanged Man
elements.desc: You gain advantage on ability checks and saving throws to see through illusions.

elements.name: The Lovers
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against the charmed condition.

elements.name: The Magician
elements.desc: Your spells of 1st level and higher ignore half and three-quarters cover so long as there is nothing between the sky and the target.

elements.name: The Sun
elements.desc: You can cast feather fall at will without expending a spell slot, and you gain immunity to falling damage.

elements.name: Temperance
elements.desc: You gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern the motives of creatures.

elements.name: The Tower
elements.desc: Damage you deal to unattended objects is tripled.

elements.name: The World
elements.desc: You learn one cantrip on the wizard spell list and it counts as a warlock cantrip for you. You can replace this cantrip with a different one from the wizard spell list whenever you finish a long rest.

elements.name: The Devil
elements.desc: You have advantage on Persuasion checks.

elements.name: The Empress
elements.desc: When you finish a short or long rest, you gain temporary hit points equal to half your warlock level.

elements.name: The Hierophant
elements.desc: You can cast water walk at will targeting only yourself without expending a spell slot. You also gain resistance to fire and acid damage.

elements.name: Justice
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot, you regain hit points equal to the level of the spell slot expended.

elements.name: The Moon
elements.desc: You can cast enlarge/reduce without expending a spell slot. Once you do so, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: The Priestess
elements.desc: While this Constellation is selected, your hit point maximum increases by your warlock level.

elements.name: The Star
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can choose to end the charmed or frightened condition on yourself. Once you do so, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Strength
elements.desc: You count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity, lifting, grappling, and shoving.

elements.name: The Wheel of Fortune
elements.desc: As a bonus action, you can create items worth 25 gp or less. They persist until you use this ability again.

elements.name: The Blade
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in medium armor and shields. Whenever you are targeted with a spell while wielding your Pact weapon, you can use a reaction to make a Charisma saving throw with disadvantage against the caster's spell save DC. If you succeed, you can choose to have the spell target another valid creature of your choosing within range.

elements.name: The Chain
elements.desc: You can use your reaction to grant your familiar immunity to one type of damage for one minute.

elements.name: The Tome
elements.desc: Whenever you are attacked, you can cast a spell or cantrip with a range of self as a reaction before the result is revealed.

elements.name: The Blade of Balance
elements.desc: Whenever you cast a cantrip while wielding your Pact weapon, you can make a single attack with it as a bonus action. Additionally, you gain proficiency in heavy armor.

elements.name: The Chain of Balance
elements.desc: Your familiar can make attacks without you taking the Attack action. It gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier.

elements.name: The Tome of Balance
elements.desc: Whenever you've cast a spell that requires concentration and affects only allies or yourself, you can temporarily dismiss it as a bonus action. During that time, it has no effect and does not require concentration. You can resume the spell as a bonus action.
